DE 12 1/4" (BHA #2) DESDE 376 ft HASTA 383 ft MD CON 400 GPM, 40 RPM, 250 PSI (Off), WOB: 10 KLBS, 350 PSI (On), TQ:4-6 KLBS-FT (Drill with directional BHA of 12 1/4" (BHA #2) from 376 ft to 383 ft MD with 400 GPM, 40 RPM, 250 PSI (Off), WOB: 10 KLBS, 350 PSI (On), TQ:4-6 KLBS-FT)
